correctness.rationale: From the known Cameron et al. maximal-null component normal form N(W,a), a rooted k-block has b1=1,b2=2,bk=k(2^{k−1}−2) choices k≥3 and order j^{k−j} when |W|=j. Labeled assembly gives exp(u C_theta(z)), with C0=B(z)=z e^{2z}−2z e^z+2z+z². Independently implemented the coefficient recurrence and reproduced published F0..F10 exactly (1,1,3,13,73,451,3211,26097,236433,2335123,24943171). For saddle n=tB′(t), the Poisson component model gives 2t=logn−2loglogn+log2+o(1), B(t)~n/logn. The characteristic-function CLT and independent Poisson X1 yield P(N=n)≥exp(−o(n/(logn)^3)), enough for Chernoff concentration of block count and exponentially rare atypical decorated blocks under conditioning. On typical blocks k≈2t, j≈k/2, so L_n∼(n/2)loglogn; Stirling yields logF_n=nlogn−nloglogn+(log2−1)n+o(n). Checked the conditioning denominator versus all concentration scales; the finite recurrence is corroboration and not an asymptotic proof.
